title: Open compact-support exchange is the extension-composition mate
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the small etale sites with the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All schemes mentioned are Noetherian [def-pc-scheme]. Compact-support direct image is the compactification-independent functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $f:X\to S$ be separated finite type and compactifiable [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $u:U\hookrightarrow S$ be open, and put $X_U=X\times_SU$, $v:X_U\hookrightarrow X$, and $f_U:X_U\to U$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use termwise open extension $Du_!,Dv_!$ with the sum/evaluation adjunctions $Du_!\dashv u^*$, $Dv_!\dashv v^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Identify compact support along an open $w$ with $Dw_!$ using the compactification $(w,\mathrm{id})$ and the refinement comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Under this normalized identification, let
$$\delta_M:Rf_!Dv_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}Du_!Rf_{U!}M$$
be $\alpha_{u,f_U}^{-1}\circ\alpha_{f,v}$, for the composition comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and $fv=uf_U$. Let $C_{f,u,F}:u^*Rf_!F\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{U!}v^*F$ be the canonical compact-support exchange. For every $F\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the morphism
$$\kappa_F=Rf_!(\varepsilon_{v,F})\circ\delta_{v^*F}^{-1}:Du_!Rf_{U!}v^*F\longrightarrow Rf_!F$$
has adjunct $C_{f,u,F}^{-1}$ under $Du_!\dashv u^*$. Equivalently,
$$\kappa_F=\varepsilon_{u,Rf_!F}\circ Du_!(C_{f,u,F}^{-1}).$$
Here $\varepsilon_u,\varepsilon_v$ are the evaluation counits. Thus the right-adjoint restriction isomorphism obtained by the Hom chain through $Dv_!$, $\delta$, and $Du_!$ is paired with this specific exchange $C_{f,u}$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. No boundedness assumption on $F$ is made.

proof.text: Choose the compactification c and its pullback. The tower normalization expresses delta inverse in terms of proper/open interchange Gamma, the derived left-adjoint square comparison a, and model-to-chosen comparisons. The private lemma open_base_change_mate identifies sheaf open base change with a mate by iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv; open_square_mate identifies its inverse mate with the conjugate of the inverse-image square. The private lemma derived_open_square_mate passes this equality to derived categories using mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate and injectivity of the open adjunction. Apply mateEquiv_counit_symm to obtain a at v star F followed by J(epsilon_v,F)=B(beta hom at F) followed by epsilon_b,JF. Naturality of the compactification comparison then gives the displayed formula for kappa.

Use the existing proper/open tower adjunct identity. Cancel the inverse open unit to get adj(Gamma_H) followed by E_BH=Q(eta_b,H). Naturality of E with h and the triangle identity give adj(Gamma_H followed by P(h)) followed by E_K followed by Q(beta inverse)=id. This is the private Lean lemma interchange_mate. The existing compact-support base-change normalization expresses the chosen exchange as the same E followed by Q(beta inverse), transported by the comparison maps. Naturality of the open adjunction and cancellation of those comparison maps give adj(kappa) followed by C=id. Since C is an isomorphism, adj(kappa)=C inverse.
Apply the inverse of the open adjunction bijection to the first equality. Its explicit counit formula gives the second conjunct.
